scope: Same exposed fourteen COD cases with identical numeric HKL values, cell/element and matched Laue/centring priors. Exact group, counts and coordinates withheld. No reference-based output selection.
acceptance: All original checks and thresholds unchanged; count actual anisotropic parameters for BIC and independent-family admission.

polishing.trigger: Full fallback effort only; promising isotropic parent with all required elements, validated recycling, no assignment disfavour and R1 <=0.18, including good own-target models so competing groups receive comparable displacement flexibility. Successful fast searches bypass extra work.
polishing.replacement: Retain original parent; compare actual parameter-penalized score and existing replacement-supported criterion after tensor-informed categorical repair.
polishing.legacy_api: Old entry points/named Python numerical profiles keep their explicit previous policy.
polishing.review_before_first_revised_run: Uniform full-effort tensor opportunity avoids comparing a successful isotropic group against a selectively richer competing group.

centring: Admit only symmorphic intensity groups: every operation translation belongs to the exact pure-translation lattice subgroup. Keep screw/glide translations unknown; full measured common-set scoring unchanged.
origin_and_stopping: Validate stored candidate hand/origin using the original bijective group-matching tolerance before retrying blind recovery. Preserve rejected candidate diagnostics. Native policy consensus limit min(original 0.1 ceiling, requested target).
grading: Same exact counts, common-origin/inversion, RMS <=0.025 A and max <=0.05 A; strict <=0.02 A and position-only secondary. All predictions saved before reference grading. Preserve failures.
controls: Normal MgSiO3 with/without prior plus forced fast timeout for MgSiO3 and acentric COD 2021040. After final normal comparison, repeat the six previously frozen extra-effort diagnostic jobs unchanged.
selection_correction: Use existing inversion-phase consistency to prefer a compatible centrosymmetric model only if its full measured common-set R1 is within the existing promising-model work ceiling of 0.18. When all models are implausible or phase-blocked, retain score ordering. This ceiling only controls selection preference, never acceptance. Keep all attempts and alternatives. Both earlier selection-regression stages are retained.
